name: Grand Hyatt Changsha
positioning: High-rise riverfront hotel at the top of a 61-storey building in Changsha, with Xiang River and city skyline views
best_for: Travelers who want a high-floor city base with Xiang River views
Families interested in Little Prince-themed rooms and connecting rooms
Guests who want Grand Club access with river and mountain views

facts.text: The hotel is on the Changsha riverfront in the capital of Hunan Province.
Orange Isle Park, the riverside promenade of Du Fu Pavilion and Wenheyou Super are steps from the hotel entrance.
The Presidential Suite has high-rise Xiang River views from floor-to-ceiling windows and spacious living, dining and reading areas.
Club Access rooms include Grand Club access for continental breakfast, all-day beverages, happy hour and evening canapes.
The 24/7 Fitness Center's locker rooms have saunas and steam rooms.
The Grand Ballroom has river views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
Xiangjiang 36, the hotel's Chinese restaurant, serves Hunan cuisine and specialty Peking duck.
Xiangjiang 36 has three show kitchens where chefs cook in view of guests.
The hotel has secure 24-hour indoor parking with an elevator directly to the lobby, and self-parking is free.

highlights.text: The hotel crowns the top of a 61-storey building with views of the Xiang River and the city skyline.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with high-rise views of the city or Xiang River from both bedroom and washroom.
Lepetie-themed family rooms are inspired by The Little Prince, with a signature welcome gift and child-friendly amenities.
The Grand Club has panoramic river and mountain views, all-day refreshments, evening cocktails and personalized service.
The heated indoor swimming pool has garden views.

considerations.text: Changsha Huanghua International Airport is 26 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
WhataHotel notes the urban business hotel setting may lack local cultural charm.
